description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Magallegama, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No.421224 (24/0294)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, cadastral map references, and location details), along with a schedule listing property owners, their identity details, extent of land, and ownership classifications. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes as it concerns land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
